title: Best Podcast Writers (2026): Scripts, Outlines and Show Notes
description: How to hire a podcast writer for scripts, episode outlines, show notes or ad reads: voice, research, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Podcast writers prepare what is said and published around an episode: full scripts for narrative shows, outlines for interviews, intros and outros, ad reads, show notes and episode descriptions. Good podcast writing sounds natural when spoken and helps listeners find and follow the show. Projects go wrong when scripts read like articles, facts are not checked, or the writer does not understand the host's voice. This guide helps you get writing that works for the ear.

faq.a: Narrative and documentary shows often use full scripts. Interview and chat shows usually work better with outlines and question lists.

faq.q: Can the writer match the host's voice?
faq.a: Send past episodes so the writer can learn how the host speaks. Read drafts aloud and adjust.
Many do. Agree on sources, fact-checking and how references are recorded.

faq.q: Can they write show notes and descriptions?
faq.a: Yes. Clear show notes help listeners and search engines understand each episode.
Usually you, once paid. Confirm in writing.
